headline: Trump's White House Party Palace 💃🏰 Gets Stopped 🚫 by Appeals Court
text:
Trump's $400M mega-ballroom 🕺💸 just got served a RESTRAINING ORDER 🛑⚖️ from the appeals court! The 2-1 ruling says 'HOLD MY GAVEL' to the Prez, telling him 'Congress calls the shots here, not your executive self-help hotline' 📞🚫

The National Trust for Historic Preservation 🏛️💪 is popping bottles 🍾 after winning their injunction, saying you can't just bulldoze the East Wing 🏚️💥 like it's a TikTok renovation without congressional permission. The three-judge panel dropped the truth bomb 💣: 'Each President is just a temporary tenant, not the landlord of the People's House!' 🏠👑

Trump's throwing a Twitter tantrum 🐦😡 calling the decision 'horrendous' and 'politically motivated,' claiming the military and Secret Service are CRYING 😭 about national security threats. Meanwhile, the dissenting judge says it's 'a blatant abuse of discretion' – classic judicial shade-throwing! 🎭

The ballroom drama includes underground security complexes 🕳️🛡️, bomb shelters 💣🏠, and medical facilities 🏥 – basically a luxury bunker for grand parties and dodging drones. Trump says it's 'vital for national security' and 'a gift to the American people' funded by private donors 💰🎁

But the appeals court hit pause on above-ground construction ⏸️🏗️ for 14 days, giving the admin time to appeal to the Supreme Court. Brent Leggs from the National Trust is celebrating: 'The White House belongs to the American people, not one man's dance floor dreams!' 💃🕺

Republicans tried to sneak $1B in taxpayer funds 💸 for Secret Service upgrades, but the budget watchdog said 'NOT TODAY, SATAN' 🐕‍🦺🚫. The ballroom project has ballooned from the original plans, with Trump doubling down after an assassination attempt at the Correspondents' dinner 🍽️💥

This legal battle royal is headed straight to SCOTUS for the ultimate showdown – will the Supreme Court let the People's House become Trump's personal ballroom blitz? 🏛️⚖️💃
